description: Fuji于1997年推出的数码相机。配备9 to 27mm Fujinon (3x) Zoom lens. Equiv. 35 to 105 mm.。快门速度1/4 sec to 1/1000 sec。感光度100, 400。有效像素1280 X 1000 max。Super Hybrid AF system with Autofocus and manual focus。

specs.镜头: 9 to 27mm Fujinon (3x) Zoom lens. Equiv. 35 to 105 mm.
specs.对焦: Super Hybrid AF system with Autofocus and manual focus
specs.英文简介: The Fujix DS-300 is an early professional digital camera released by Fujifilm in 1997.
